test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’. Then I unfurled the Indian tri-colour and __keep__ it aloft at the roof of the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the verb tense used. "**Keep**" should be in the past tense to match the past action described in the sentence.
 
• The correct verb should be "**held**" to indicate that the action has been completed in the past.
 
• The sentence should read: "Then I unfurled the Indian tri-colour and held it aloft at the roof of the world."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
